# The OpenMixer package families: the names the OpenMixer channel serves from Open-Mixer's own sources, one shell glob
# per line. installs.sh reads an install line's package only when its name is one of these: a CI job may install a
# tool of the distribution or of a third-party repository as it needs, but an OpenMixer package it installs by hand
# must be one the repository's packaging declares (.github#257). A new Open-Mixer source repository adds its
# family here.
omx-*
libomx*
python3-omx*
plugin-hostd*
libplugin-hostd*
python3-plugin-hostd*
plugin-db*
libplugin-db*
plugin-qualify*
plugin-qualification*
libplugin-qualification*
mod-host*
openmixer*
libsurface*
libmackie*
libdiginet*
diginet*
